description: This Java class 'MultiMapInjectAdapter' acts as an adapter for injecting tracing properties into a Vert.x MultiMap, implementing the OpenTracing TextMap interface.

classes.name: MultiMapInjectAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class that implements the OpenTracing TextMap interface to facilitate injecting tracing context into a Vert.x MultiMap object.

methods.name: MultiMapInjectAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a given MultiMap; throws NullPointerException if null.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Unsupported operation; throws UnsupportedOperationException when called as it is not used for injection.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the MultiMap, ensuring neither key nor value is null.
